lesson.title: The Silk Road - Connecting Cultures
learningObjectives: Explain why the Silk Road mattered
Name goods that travelled along it

scenes.narration: The Silk Road was a network of trade routes that connected East and West for over 1,500 years.
onScreenText: Trade Routes of the Ancient World
scenes.visualDescription: Map of Asia with glowing trade routes connecting cities.

scenes.narration: Silk, spices and paper travelled west, while glass and gold travelled east. Ideas and cultures travelled too.
scenes.visualDescription: Animated caravan crossing a desert map with arrows.

scenes.narration: The Silk Road shaped world history by connecting distant civilisations.
scenes.visualDescription: Two hands meeting over a globe.
